chore: version packages (#12277)

This PR was opened by the [Changesets
release](https://github.com/changesets/action) GitHub action. When
you're ready to do a release, you can merge this and the packages will
be published to npm automatically. If you're not ready to do a release
yet, that's fine, whenever you add more changesets to main, this PR will
be updated.


# Releases
## @langchain/core@1.5.0

### Minor Changes

- [#12252](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12252)
[`bbf8a1a`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/commit/bbf8a1af2c668223fd7ac570f0f5b3a4318e3095)
Thanks
[@thushanth-bengre-langchain](https://github.com/thushanth-bengre-langchain)!
- Standardize finish reason on `message-finish` events and final
`AIMessage`s. Provider integrations set `finish_reason` (raw provider
value), `normalized_finish_reason` (`stop | length | tool_call |
content_filter | refusal | context_exceeded | error | other`) and, for
Anthropic, `finish_state` (`complete | suspended`) in
`response_metadata`; events carry them as `finishReason`,
`normalizedFinishReason` and `finishState`. Core no longer maps provider
values: it passes these fields through and corrects two
provider-agnostic cases (a refusal block becomes `refusal`, and `stop`
with tool calls becomes `tool_call`). The `FinishReason` type changes
from `stop | length | tool_use | content_filter` to the values above
(`tool_use` is now `tool_call`). `MessageFinishEvent.reason` is
deprecated but still emitted with its old values (`tool_call` maps to
`tool_use`, `refusal` to `content_filter`, `context_exceeded` to
`length`; left unset for `other` and `error`).
`response_metadata.finish_reason` on streamed messages now holds the raw
provider value instead of the normalized one.

[@thushanth-bengre-langchain](https://github.com/thushanth-bengre-langchain)!
- Set `finish_reason` (the `stop_reason`), `normalized_finish_reason`
and `finish_state` in `response_metadata` on `invoke` and streamed
results, and emit them on `message-finish`. `refusal` and
`model_context_window_exceeded` map to `refusal` and `context_exceeded`,
and `pause_turn` sets `finish_state: "suspended"`.

-"@langchain/core": minor
----
-
-Standardize finish reason on `message-finish` events and final `AIMessage`s. Provider integrations set `finish_reason` (raw provider value), `normalized_finish_reason` (`stop | length | tool_call | content_filter | refusal | context_exceeded | error | other`) and, for Anthropic, `finish_state` (`complete | suspended`) in `response_metadata`; events carry them as `finishReason`, `normalizedFinishReason` and `finishState`. Core no longer maps provider values: it passes these fields through and corrects two provider-agnostic cases (a refusal block becomes `refusal`, and `stop` with tool calls becomes `tool_call`). The `FinishReason` type changes from `stop | length | tool_use | content_filter` to the values above (`tool_use` is now `tool_call`). `MessageFinishEvent.reason` is deprecated but still emitted with its old values (`tool_call` maps to `tool_use`, `refusal` to `content_filter`, `context_exceeded` to `length`; left unset for `other` and `error`). `response_metadata.finish_reason` on streamed messages now holds the raw provider value instead of the normalized one.
